copperheadhq/copperhead.question: What if animesh-chouhan leaves copperhead?
copperheadhq/copperhead.answer: **625 of 780 files** animesh-chouhan has touched would have **no other human** who authored or reviewed a PR on them (80%). animesh-chouhan is on 67 of 200 cached PRs. Most exposed: `src/kicad/draft/engine.ts`, `manual-tests/reference-boards/buck-12v-5v/reference/buck-12v-5v.png`, `manual-tests/reference-boards/npn-switch/reference/npn-switch.png`. By area: intake (150), openspec (130), test (120), manual-tests (101).

tool_calls.cypher:
MATCH (me:Person {login:$person})-[:AUTHORED|REVIEWED]->(p:PR)-[:IN_REPO]->(:Repo {id:$repo})
WHERE p.created >= $since
MATCH (p)-[:TOUCHES]->(f:File)
WITH DISTINCT me, f
MATCH (h:Person)-[:AUTHORED|REVIEWED]->(q:PR)-[:TOUCHES]->(f)
WHERE q.created >= $since AND NOT coalesce(h.is_bot, false)
WITH me, f, collect(DISTINCT h) AS humans, count(DISTINCT q) AS prs
WHERE size(humans) = 1 AND humans[0] = me
MATCH path = (me)-[:AUTHORED|REVIEWED]->(:PR)-[:TOUCHES]->(f)
WITH f, prs, collect(path) AS paths
RETURN f.path AS file, prs, 0 AS remaining_humans, paths[0..$max_paths] AS evidence
ORDER BY prs DESC, file LIMIT $k
